# Origin-effect scalar supports (Precise: Superpower / Friend of Spirit Magi)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Precise: Superpower, Friend of Spirit Magi, Precise: Friend of Spirit Magi
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, spirit-magus, support

## Derived / confirmed formula

'N% Origin of Spirit Magus effect for the supported skill' feeds the INCREASED half of that magus's OWN origin factor: factor = (1 + global inc + this support's N%) x (1 + additional). Per-level N from the support progression (Superpower 48.2 -> 52 L20 -> 56 L40, unconditional; Friend 51.2 -> 55 L20 -> 59 L40 gated on >=2 distinct magus types slotted; Precise Friend +109 -> +148 L40 gated on >=3 types). Type count = distinct magus types that actually granted an origin.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped, unverified. Owner-classified (2026-08-10) as INCREASED-pool lines ('99.99% sure') — not measured in-game. Assumptions: per-skill scoping (each support scales only its own magus's origin); and the Friend gate reading — in-game 'having at least N type(s) of Spirit Magus at the same time' means SUMMONED/ACTIVE magi, while the app counts slotted+enabled summon skills that granted an origin (equivalent whenever slotted magi are actually summoned; diverges if a slotted magus is not summoned in play).

## Implementation (engine model)

engine/spirit_magus_origins.py SCALAR_ORIGIN_SUPPORTS + scalar_support_value + origin_factor; compute.py scan collects per-magus contributions and applies the type-count gate post-scan (<flag>_support_inc conditions); aggregator + origin_summary use the per-origin factor. Magnificent added effects scale with their OWNER origin's factor (ORIGIN_OWNER_FLAG).
